title: cruciata ciliata f. mucronata
intro: Cruciata ciliata f. mucronata, commonly known as small bugle, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family, traditionally used in folk medicine. The health benefits of Cruciata ciliata f. mucronata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce fever, and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Cruciata ciliata f. mucronata include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
